title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Provisions on the Oath of Judges of the People's Republic of China (for Trial Implementation)
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Oath-taking Provisions for Judges of the People's Republic of China (Trial)

Fa Fa [2012] No. 27

To the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Oath-taking Provisions for Judges of the People's Republic of China (Trial) are hereby issued for your diligent compliance and implementation.

December 19, 2012

Oath-taking Provisions for Judges of the People's Republic of China (Trial)

Article 1 These Provisions are formulated in accordance with the Judges Law of the People's Republic of China, the Civil Servant Law of the People's Republic of China, and other laws, for the purpose of strengthening the building of the judge contingent and enhancing judges' sense of professional mission, responsibility, and honor.

Article 2 Persons assuming or reassuming the office of a judge for the first time shall, by means of publicly declaring the oath, make a solemn commitment to faithfully implement the Constitution and laws, wholeheartedly serve the people, administer justice impartially and incorruptibly, and consciously accept supervision.

Article 3 The oath-taking of a judge shall be organized and implemented by the people's court at the same level or the people's court at a higher level.

Article 4 The oath of a judge is as follows: I am a judge of the People's Republic of China. I swear: to be loyal to the motherland, loyal to the people, loyal to the Constitution and laws, faithfully perform the duties of a judge, abide by judicial ethics, comply with the code of conduct for judges, administer justice impartially, administer justice with integrity, administer justice for the people, and strive to safeguard social fairness and justice!

Article 5 The national flag must be hung at the oath-taking venue.

The oath leader and the oath taker shall uniformly wear judicial robes or other judge uniform attire.

Article 6 The oath leader shall be the president of the people's court at each level or a senior judge authorized by the president.

Article 7 At the beginning of the oath-taking ceremony, the national anthem of the People's Republic of China shall be played (sung); the oath taker shall face the national flag, stand at attention, raise the right hand, and form a fist at shoulder level; the oath leader, in the same stance, shall stand in front of the oath taker, read the oath sentence by sentence, and the oath taker shall repeat it in unison; after the recitation of the oath is completed, the oath taker shall, after the oath leader utters the words "the oath taker," state his or her own name.

Article 8 Activities for reaffirming the oath organized by people's courts at all levels when holding important events shall be conducted by reference to these Provisions.

Article 9 These Provisions shall be interpreted by the Supreme People's Court.

Article 10 These Provisions shall come into effect as of the date of issuance.
